title: Robin Hood, the clever fox.
lines: A fox lives in Sherwood Forest.
His name is Robin Hood.
He wears a green hat with a red feather.
And he has a bow and arrows.
Robin Hood lives with his best friend.
Little John.
Little John is actually a big bear.
He isn't little, he's enormous!
There's a mean king in the land.
Prince John.
He's a skinny little lion with a crown that's too big.
He always sucks his thumb when he's angry.
Prince John loves gold.
Lots of gold.
His helper, the sheriff, is a fat wolf.
The sheriff takes money from everyone.
Even from the poor animals.
Even from a little bunny whose birthday it is.
The bunny got one coin for his birthday.
The sheriff takes it away.
Robin Hood sees it.
That's not fair!
He takes the money back from the rich.
And he gives it to the poor.
He dresses up as an old woman.
Or as a beggar.
That way he can secretly get close to the king.
Robin Hood gives the bunny a hat and a bow and arrow.
For your birthday, says Robin.
The bunny shoots an arrow.
The arrow flies over the wall.
Right into the castle garden.
Marian lives there.
A sweet vixen.
She's Robin Hood's sweetheart from long ago.
Prince John holds an archery contest.
The winner gets a golden arrow.
And a kiss from Marian.
Robin Hood wants to take part.
But it's a trap!
Prince John wants to catch him.
Robin dresses up as a stork.
With long legs and a yellow beak.
Nobody recognises him.
He shoots.
A hit!
Right in the bullseye.
He wins!
But then his disguise falls off.
The soldiers grab him.
Little John helps.
He dresses up too.
Together they escape.
With Marian.
Everyone dances in the forest.
That night Robin and Little John sneak into the castle.
They take all the bags of gold.
They give it back to all the animals in the village.
Then the good King Richard comes back from a long journey.
He sends Prince John and the sheriff away.
Now they have to break stones.
Robin Hood and Marian get married.
The bunny carries the veil.
Everyone in the forest has a party.
The end.
